title: Stuff shoe with newspaper
setting: Footwear factory, long table of black sneakers
masks_caveat: the newspaper pad and the paper the worker handles are outlined separately: "Newspaper (sheet and ball)" follows the sheet from the tear at 0.4 s through crumpling and wrapping into a ball, and the wad into the shoe until it disappears inside at about 6.1 s; while the sheet is still part of the pad, or wrapped inside the hands, its outline can be small. The shoe outline follows the shoe being worked on; the other shoes in the row are not outlined.
contact_roles: the hands tear a sheet from the pad, crumple it and wrap it into a ball, then push it into the shoe while the left hand steadies the shoe. Much of this clip's contact was set by a reviewer watching the video, because the paper changes shape in the hands faster than the automatic cues follow (those frames are marked as reviewer-corrected in the data).
